text:
dave: starting change window for ranking-service v5.4.0 in prod. plan: 10% -> 60% over 18m. gating on p95 and 5xx. kicking off 10% canary now.

deploy-bot: rollout started by dave. env=prod, version=v5.4.0, steps=[10%:9m,60%:9m]. auto-rollback thresholds: p95>700ms or 5xx>0.5% sustained 2m.

monitoring-bot: baseline p95=140ms, current p95(3m)=150ms. 5xx baseline=0.06%, current=0.07%. no hard alarms. will post deltas.

elle: seeing a small cluster of p95 spikes on /rank/top in us-west around +4m. tail to ~480ms, small number of 502s. tracing now.

infra: k8s event: pod ranking-9a2 on node-w2 restarted (OOMKilled) at 2026-03-22T21:10:32Z.

dave: hold ramp. keep at 10%. monitoring-bot, diff top endpoints pre/post and list nodes. can we pin traffic back to v5.3.9 if needed?

monitoring-bot: delta(5m pre vs 5m post): /rank/top p95 +220ms, 5xx +0.18%. nodes: node-w2, node-w5 show highest delta. recommendation: divert canary to warmed pool or apply runtime-fallback-quant for /rank/top.

elle: logs show `OOMKilled` and model cache fill spikes on node-w2. infra, can we spin warmed-pool(2nodes) with larger heap and route the 10% there?

infra: provisioning warmed-pool(2nodes, heap=3.5G) now. ETA ~90s.

dave: decision: divert 10% to warmed-pool and annotate change window: "diverted to warmed-pool due to memory pressure; hold ramp". if metrics don't stabilize in 10m, pin to v5.3.9.

deploy-bot: actioned: traffic diverged to warmed-pool; change window note appended. auto-rollback still armed.

monitoring-bot: post-diversion 4m: p95 improving to 165ms, 5xx back to 0.08%. continuing 10m watch.

dave: thanks all. i'll update release notes and open INFRA-2130 to investigate node memory and cache warmup. follow-up sync in 15m. :white_check_mark:
